checks.name: ground_truth_isolation
checks.detail: Historical needs-analysis narrative, legacy questionnaire results, legacy needs list and KNOWN_DEFECTS were not opened during blind derivation.

checks.name: historical_cutoff
checks.detail: Evidence admitted to need derivation is dated/period-correct for <= 2024-01-12; a post-cutoff AJOFM 2023 activity report was explicitly excluded.

checks.name: official_first
checks.detail: Primary chains use AJOFM/ANOFM, Ministry of Education, ISJ Vâlcea and ARACIP evidence. Unofficial mirrors are discovery-only.

checks.name: territorial_specificity
checks.detail: School offer and county labour-market evidence are available. No school-level outcomes survey or practice-quality baseline is available in blind corpus.

checks.name: rate_share_semantics
checks.detail: Under-30 registered unemployed are expressed as a share/count of registered unemployed, never as a youth unemployment rate.

checks.name: school_level_non_projection
checks.detail: National dropout, counselling, infrastructure or practice-system findings are not silently attributed to Pleșoianu.

checks.name: need_evidence_chain
checks.detail: Every primary blind need has at least two evidence items and at least one official evidence chain; BN-06 is explicitly supporting context only.

checks.name: unsupported_discrimination_need
checks.detail: Discrimination was rejected as a primary blind need because compliance obligations do not establish prevalence in the target group.

checks.name: causal_restraint
checks.detail: Cross-sectional statistics are used to establish context/relevance, not project causality or individual outcomes.

checks.name: indicator_traceability
checks.detail: Primary intervention chains are traceable to EECO06+07=251 and, where logically applicable, EECR03=226 without inventing an employment indicator.

checks.name: publication_provenance
checks.detail: AJOFM Vâlcea 2023 forecast is official and explicitly a 2023 programme-planning document, but migrated-page publication timestamp is not independently frozen; it is therefore conditional evidence and not sole support for any high-severity need.

checks.name: primary_research_gap_detection
checks.detail: The run explicitly requests student-level primary research before making school-specific statements about career indecision, perceived practice deficits or skills gaps.

nonblocking_gaps: AJOFM forecast original publication timestamp/hash receipt
